name: sourcetomcp
stderr:
Usage: sourcetomcp [options] [command]

Ask questions against your connected SourcetoMCP data straight from the
terminal.

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]           Sign in to SourcetoMCP via your browser
  logout                    Clear the stored SourcetoMCP session
  whoami                    Show which SourcetoMCP account is currently
                            connected
  connections               List your connected sources
  auth                      Manage the local LLM API keys used to power `ask`
  config                    Manage CLI settings
  ask [options] <question>  Ask a natural-language question against your
                            connected data
  help [command]            display help for command
